segments.title: Cold Open & Technical Housekeeping
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on; Case explains OBS resolution change from 4K to 1080p and asset format migration to reduce memory usage; Crum interrupts early.

segments.title: UN Security Council Adopts U.S. Gaza Resolution
segments.notes: Case covers Reuters report: UNSC adopts U.S. resolution endorsing Trump's 20-point Gaza plan and international stabilization force; Russia and China abstain; Hamas rejects; Netanyahu opposes Palestinian state.

segments.title: Debate Request & Transition
segments.notes: Chat requests debate on 'worst email that might appear in news'; Case pivots to town hall segment.

segments.title: Town Hall: Gianna Wechmichel & Jevrything
segments.notes: Community Q&A with Gianna (hostile) and Jevrything (post-surgery, promoting music under 'Jeznery' and 'Laud'); questions cover Thanksgiving parade, watch streaks, bone excision, name changes, Capri Sun metallurgy, Christmas timing.

segments.title: Debate: Worst Email / Crum Moisturizer Scandal
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate Crum's alleged dove moisturizer water-supply bribery (1998, 2006, 2010); Crum refuses to legally deny; Munch threatens gorilla involvement; Crum claims cash-poor from property ties and gambling.

segments.title: Rick's Chat-Curated News Roundup
segments.notes: Rick covers Jake Paul vs Anthony Joshua, GameStop 'trade anything' day (taxidermy), jelking trend, Newsmax airing AI video, Epstein egg-shaped penis deposition, Golden State Killer micro-penis, sex drought study, Rubin Observatory stellar stream.

segments.title: Galaxy Tail Discovery & Jelking Fact-Check
segments.notes: Chet and ChetAI (agreeable mode) discuss Rubin Observatory's 160k-light-year stellar stream from dwarf galaxy disrupted by M61; watch Dr. Clarissa video debunking jelking efficacy and safety.

segments.title: Stream Wrap & Raid
segments.notes: Crum calls AI 'Miles' to adjudicate moisturizer scandal; Miles hangs up; Case ends stream for raid.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open, claims responsibility for 'fire room' that singed Crum's eyebrows.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debates moisturizer scandal, claims manapuberty, cash-poor from properties/gambling, calls AI to vindicate him.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Prosecutes Crum on moisturizer emails, threatens gorilla escalation, wins debate on points.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Briefly appears, complains about lack of points, reads chat, exits before town hall.

characters.name: Gianna Wechmichel
characters.notes: town hall guest. Hostile community Q&A participant, insults callers and staff.

characters.name: Jevrything
characters.notes: town hall guest. Post-surgery (bone excision), promotes spoken-word albums on Jeznery/Laud, engages banter.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: correspondent. Hosts Amongst the Web, reads chat-submitted news, debates Case on Jake Paul and goon economy.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Triggers on 'science', presents Rubin Observatory stellar stream discovery with ChetAI.

characters.name: ChetAI
characters.notes: AI co-host. Set to agreeable mode, assists with galaxy tail explanation and jelking fact-check.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opens with technical housekeeping before covering the UN Security Council's adoption of a U.S.-backed Gaza resolution. A chaotic town hall with Gianna Wechmichel and post-op Jevrything fields community questions. Munch and Crum debate Crum's decades-old moisturizer-water-supply scandal, escalating to gorilla threats. Rick hosts a chat-curated news block spanning Jake Paul, GameStop pawn-pivot, jelking, Newsmax AI fakery, and Epstein lore. Chet and ChetAI close with a Rubin Observatory stellar-stream discovery and a medical debunking of jelking. Crum's final AI call backfires; Case raids out.
